observations.finding: 25/50 Hallmark pathways significant at q<0.05; strongest effects are down-regulation of fatty acid metabolism (SMD -1.16, q=0.0), adipogenesis (SMD -1.07, q=2.5e-05), heme metabolism (SMD -0.95, q=2.3e-04), and pancreas beta cells (SMD -0.97, q=2.8e-04), with up-regulation of coagulation (SMD 0.82, q=7.5e-04) and EMT (SMD 0.87, q=1.9e-03).
No gene significant at q<0.05 (min q=0.316); nominal SETD2 enrichment (14.7% vs 1.4%, OR 11.7, 95% CI 1.31-104.8, p=0.014) and VHL/PBRM1 trends do not survive multiple-testing correction.

16/49 continuous features and 5/107 gain/loss features significant at q<0.05; CDKN2A loss enriched (44.1% vs 14.5%, OR 4.66, q=0.019), chr9q loss (41.2% vs 11.6%, OR 5.34, q=0.019), chr20p gain (29.4% vs 4.3%, OR 9.17, q=0.011), chr20q gain (32.4% vs 7.2%, OR 6.12, q=0.026), JAK2 loss (38.2% vs 13.0%, OR 4.13, q=0.044).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: C0001 shows a strong, coherent RNA signal (half of tested pathways significant, large effect sizes) and a coherent CNV signal (CDKN2A/9q loss, 20p/20q gain). WXS is non-significant after correction, with only nominal SETD2 enrichment.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0001 has substantial molecular evidence of a distinct expression and copy-number profile, consistent with a metabolically altered ccRCC phenotype; mutation evidence is weak and does not independently define the set.
limitations: WXS findings are nominal only and not significant after correction.
Pathway and CNV signals are relative to the rest of the partition and do not establish clinical or prognostic meaning.

observations.finding: 13/50 Hallmark pathways significant at q<0.05; top effects are up-regulation of pancreas beta cells (SMD 1.13, q=5e-04), WNT/beta-catenin (SMD 0.74, q=0.012), TGF-beta (SMD 0.72, q=0.009), myogenesis (SMD 0.72, q=0.012), and down-regulation of allograft rejection (SMD -0.72, q=0.006) and IL6/JAK/STAT3 (SMD -0.68, q=0.007).

No gene significant at q<0.05 (min q=0.223); nominal VHL enrichment (76.9% vs 46.8%, OR 3.80, 95% CI 1.37-10.49, p=0.011) and PBRM1 enrichment (57.7% vs 31.2%, OR 3.01, p=0.020) with BAP1 depletion (0% vs 16.9%, p=0.035) do not survive correction.

14/49 continuous features and 3/107 gain/loss features significant at q<0.05; lower chr20q, chr12p, chr7p, chr7q, chr12q; chr14q loss depleted (15.4% vs 49.4%, OR 0.19, q=0.033), chr7q gain absent (0% vs 26.0%, q=0.034), CDKN2A loss depleted (3.8% vs 31.2%, q=0.038).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: C0002 shows a moderate, coherent RNA signal and a coherent CNV signal characterized by depletion of several losses/gains seen elsewhere. WXS is non-significant after correction with nominal VHL/PBRM1 enrichment.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0002 has moderate molecular evidence of a distinct expression and copy-number profile; mutation evidence is weak and does not independently define the set.
limitations: WXS findings are nominal only and not significant after correction.
Signals are relative to the rest of the partition and do not establish clinical meaning.

observations.finding: 9/50 Hallmark pathways significant at q<0.05; top effects are up-regulation of interferon alpha (SMD 0.93, q=0.024) and interferon gamma (SMD 0.81, q=0.029) responses, allograft rejection (SMD 0.70, q=0.029), and ROS pathway (SMD 0.71, q=0.030), with down-regulation of myogenesis (SMD -0.81, q=0.029) and WNT/beta-catenin (SMD -0.74, q=0.029).

BAP1 strongly enriched (50.0% vs 2.5%, OR 39.5, 95% CI 7.71-202.3, q=4.8e-06); nominal SPTA1 (18.2% vs 2.5%, OR 8.78, q=0.199) and TTN (22.7% vs 6.2%, OR 4.47, q=0.253) enrichment; VHL depleted (36.4% vs 59.3%, OR 0.39, q=0.484).

2/49 continuous features significant at q<0.05 (PTEN higher, SMD 0.51, q=0.036; chr10q higher, SMD 0.49, q=0.038); no gain/loss feature significant (min q=0.339), though chr14q loss is nominally enriched (63.6% vs 34.6%, OR 3.31, q=0.339).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: C0003 shows a coherent immune/interferon RNA signal and a strong, coherent WXS signal driven by BAP1 enrichment. CNV evidence is weak (only two continuous features significant, no gain/loss features significant).
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0003 has strong mutation-based and moderate immune-expression evidence of a distinct molecular profile; copy-number evidence is weak.
limitations: CNV gain/loss findings are non-significant after correction.
Signals are relative to the rest of the partition and do not establish clinical meaning.

observations.finding: 0/50 Hallmark pathways significant at q<0.05 (min q=0.053); top effects are directionally down for IL6/JAK/STAT3 (SMD -0.89), coagulation (SMD -0.88), TNFA/NFKB (SMD -0.86), glycolysis (SMD -0.79), and inflammatory response (SMD -0.79), all just above the significance threshold.

No continuous feature significant at q<0.05 (min q=0.235) and no gain/loss feature significant (min q=0.235); nominal chr1p loss (23.8% vs 2.4%, OR 12.5, q=0.235) and chr1q loss (14.3% vs 0%, q=0.235).

evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0004 has strong mutation-based evidence of a distinct molecular profile (PBRM1/VHL-depleted), with weak, directionally consistent expression and copy-number support.
limitations: RNA and CNV findings are non-significant after correction.

actions.reason: C0001 has coherent RNA and CNV identity evidence, consistently positive cross-modal membership and boundary support, and no significant technical confounder; it is retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0002 has moderate coherent RNA and CNV identity evidence with positive cross-modal membership and boundary support; a tissue-source-site association is present but does not by itself establish artifact, so the candidate is retained with this limitation noted.

C0003 has strong BAP1-driven mutation evidence and coherent immune/interferon expression support with the most consistent cross-modal membership and boundary separation; a tissue-source-site association is present but does not by itself establish artifact, so it is retained with this limitation noted.

C0004 has strong coherent PBRM1/VHL-depletion mutation evidence and positive fused boundary separation from all other sets, with no significant technical confounder; cross-modal support is largely WXS-driven, which is a noted limitation but not a basis for dropping the candidate.
